name: Energy, Dynamic Price
description: Dynamic (EPEX day-ahead) electricity prices for today, plus tomorrow once published (~13:00). Stepped price curve in 15-minute or hourly slots with the lowest and highest price marked and a subtle 'now' marker. Data from EnergyZero (no key) or your Tibber account.

cell_options.name: source
cell_options.label: Price source
cell_options.help: EnergyZero publishes the Dutch EPEX day-ahead prices for free. Tibber shows your own contract price, exactly as in the Tibber app; add your token under Settings › Widgets › Energy, Dynamic Price.

cell_options.name: price_type
cell_options.label: Price
cell_options.help: All-in = EPEX market price + energy tax + purchasing fee.

choices.label: From now on (rest of today + tomorrow)

cell_options.name: title
cell_options.label: Title
cell_options.help: Leave empty for 'Electricity price' in the display language.

cell_options.name: battery_device
cell_options.label: Home battery
cell_options.help: A Deye inverter from the Solarman integration: its time-of-use targets as a dashed blue line over the prices (on an axis of their own, 0–100% on the right), slots that charge from the grid drawn heavy with a pylon, the current slot outlined, and the battery's state of charge today as a pale blue line. Needs the Home Assistant Core plugin and the Home batteries widget installed beside this one. Kept as a secret.

cell_options.name: battery_history
cell_options.label: Home battery: today's state of charge
cell_options.help: The pale blue line of the battery's state of charge from midnight to now, from Home Assistant's history.

cell_options.name: grid_min_soc
cell_options.label: Home battery: grid charging counts from
cell_options.help: A slot set to charge from the grid with a target this low charges nothing; it is drawn as a plain slot.

cell_options.name: language
cell_options.label: Language
cell_options.help: The widget's words in this language, whatever the dashboard's. Set the same on every widget of a page for one language throughout.

settings.name: tibber_token
settings.label: Tibber API token
settings.help: Create one at developer.tibber.com → Access token. Only needed for the Tibber source.

settings.name: tibber_home_id
settings.label: Tibber home ID
settings.help: Only when your account has more than one home. Empty = first home with an active contract.

settings.name: timezone
settings.label: Time zone
settings.help: IANA zone used for Tibber's day boundaries (EnergyZero always uses Europe/Amsterdam).
